spans.s: व्रज् vt. 1P (pres. व्रजति) 1. To go, to proceed, न चोच्छिष्टः क्वचिद् व्रजेत् M.ii.56; 2. to pass away (as time). (This verb is used in many of the senses of गम् q.v.).With अनु-, 1. to follow, M.xi.111; 2. to perform.With परि-, to wander about as a mendicant.With प्र-, 1. to go into exile; 2. to renounce the world, to enter on the fourth stage of life, to become a Sannyāsin, M.vi.39.With प्रति-, to go to or towards, Bt.viii.96.With प्रत्युद्-, to go out to meet.

व्रज m. 1. A flock, a multitude, रुचिरचित्रतनूरुहशालिभिर्विचलितैः परितः प्रियकव्रजैः Sis.iv.32, R.vi.7; 2. a station of cowherds; 3. a cowpen; 4. a road; 5. an abode; 6. name of a district near Mathurā, Bh.V.ii.165, 179.
व्रज-अंगना f. a woman of Vraja, a cowherdess, Bh.V.ii.165, 179.
व्रज-अजिर n. a cowpen.
व्रज-किशोर, -नाथ, -मोहन, -वर, -वल्लभ m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
व्रज-किशोर, -नाथ, -मोहन, -वर, -वल्लभ m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
व्रज-किशोर, -नाथ, -मोहन, -वर, -वल्लभ m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
व्रज-किशोर, -नाथ, -मोहन, -वर, -वल्लभ m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
व्रज-किशोर, -नाथ, -मोहन, -वर, -वल्लभ m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
व्रजन m. 1. Roaming, wandering; 2. exile.
व्रज्या f. 1. Wandering about as a mendicant; 2. a march, an attack; 3. a flock, a tribe, a multitude; 4. a theatre.
व्रण् (I) vi. 1P (pres. व्रणति) To sound.
व्रण् (II) vt. 10U (pres. व्रणयति-ते) To wound.
व्रण m.n. A wound, a sore, a bruise, R.xii.99, iii.68.
व्रण-अश m. gum-myrrh.
व्रण-कृत् m. the marking-nut plant.
व्रण-विरोपण a. healing a wound, Sak.iv.
व्रण-शोधन n. the cleansing of a sore.
व्रण-ह m. the castor-oil plant.

व्रत m.n. 1. A rite, an observance; 2. design, plan; 3. vow, resolution, सो‍‍ऽभूद्भग्नव्रतः शत्रूनुद्धृत्य प्रतिरोपयन् R.xvii.42; 4. course of conduct; 5. devotion, faithfulness, devoted worship, यांति देवव्रता देवान् पितॄन् यांति पितृव्रताः Bg.ix.25; 6. a religious act of devotion or austerity; (there are innumerable Vratas enjoined in the Purāṇas and additions are being made even to the present day), R.ii.4, 25.
व्रात (I) m. A multitude, a flock, an assemblage.
व्रात (II) n. 1. Bodily labour; 2. casual employment.
व्रत-आचरण n. the observance of a vow.
व्रत-आदेश m. investiture with the sacred thread.
व्रत-चर्य m. a religious student.
व्रत-चर्या f. practice of a religious vow.
व्रत-पारण n. conclusion of a fast.
व्रत-पारणा f. conclusion of a fast.
व्रत-भंग m. breach of a religious vow.
व्रत-भिक्षा f. soliciting alms as part of the ceremony of investiture with the thread.
व्रत-वैकल्य n. incompletion of a religious vow.
व्रत-स्नातक m. a Brāhmaṇa who has completed his first stage of life, viz., that of religious studentship.
व्रतति(ती) f. 1. A creeper, पादाकृष्टव्रततिवलयासंगसंजातपाशः Sak.i.; 2. expansion.
व्रतति(ती) f. 1. A creeper, पादाकृष्टव्रततिवलयासंगसंजातपाशः Sak.i.; 2. expansion.
व्रतिन् m. 1. One who institutes a sacrifice; 2. a religious student; 3. an ascetic.
व्रध्न m. The same as ब्रध्न q.v.
व्रश्च् vt. 6P (pp. वृक्ण; pres. वृश्चति; desid. विव्रश्चिषति or विव्रक्षति) 1. To cut, to tear, to cut asunder; 2. to wound.
व्रश्चन (I) m. A fine instrument used by goldsmiths.
व्रश्चन (II) n. Cutting, wounding.
व्राजि f. A gust of wind.
व्रातीन a. (f. ना) Hired for labour.
व्रातीन a. (f. ना) Hired for labour.
व्रात्य m. 1. A man of any of the first three castes over whom the purificatory ceremonies are not performed, भव्त्या हि व्रात्याधमपतितपाषंडपरिषत्परित्राणस्नेहः श्लथयितुमशक्यः खलि यदा G.
; 2. a low person in general.
व्रात्य-ब्रुव m. one who calls himself a Vrātya.
व्रात्य-स्तोम m. name of a particular sacrifice.
